source.title: Anforderungen an Anwendungen im Gesundheitswesen – Teil 1: Mobile Anwendungen
Kryptographische Verfahren: Empfehlungen und Schlüssellängen – Teil 2: Verwendung von Transport Layer Security (TLS)

requirements.title: Einholung einer Einwilligungserklärung des Nutzers.
requirements.toolCoverage: Compares when each connection opened with the consent markers placed during the session. A connection opened before consent is network activity, not proof that personal data was processed, and the tunnel cannot tell which app opened it.

requirements.title: Weitergabe von sensiblen Daten nur für den primären oder rechtmäßigen Zweck.
requirements.toolCoverage: Compares the host of each connection with the project's allowlist, and lists the connections that had no name to compare. A host outside the allowlist is a connection to an unlisted party; whether sensitive data was sent to it, and whether the user agreed, is not observed.

requirements.title: Netzwerkkommunikation durchgängig mit gegenseitiger Authentisierung verschlüsselt.
requirements.toolCoverage: Raised only by an HTTP request that was seen in the clear. Mutual authentication is not observed: a connection seen to be encrypted says nothing about a client certificate.

requirements.title: Konfiguration der verschlüsselten Verbindung gemäß aktuellem Stand der Technik.
requirements.toolCoverage: Compares the negotiated TLS version with the lowest one TR-02102-2 recommends. Cipher suites, key agreement groups and signature algorithms are not compared with its tables.

requirements.title: Sichere Kommunikationskanäle nur mit Betriebssystem-Funktionen oder sicherheitsüberprüfter Drittsoftware.
Unterstützung von Zertifikats-Pinning.
requirements.toolCoverage: Reads, per host, whether connections accepted or refused a certificate issued by the local inspection CA, and only in a session recorded with inspection on and that CA trusted. A refusal does not tell pinning apart from refusing every user-installed root, it may predate the session, and nothing is bypassed to find out more.

requirements.title: Validierung der Integrität und Authentizität der Antworten des Hintergrundsystems.
Vorhaltung von vollständigen Log-Dateien für alle aufgebauten Verbindungen.
